# Reference

> Reference is a supersonic creative studio. We make bold, entertainment-led work for brands who want to win.

Reference was founded by two senior creatives with careers spanning Leo Burnett, BBDO, Publicis, AKQA, and client-side roles at major brands. Based in the Middle East. Small team. Senior people. Hands-on from start to finish.

## What We Do

- Brand campaigns and integrated creative
- Social and digital content (Instagram, TikTok, Twitter/X, YouTube)
- Entertainment-led campaigns for streaming, FMCG, sports, and telecoms
- Strategy, concept, production and delivery — from first thought to final frame

## Selected Work

- **Shahid — The Devil's Promise**: Contextual pre-launch campaign for a Shahid Original series. The most successful pre-launch campaign in Shahid's history.
- **Shahid — Epic Originals**: Brand campaign for the Shahid streaming platform.
- **Shahid — No Escape**: Campaign for Shahid.
- **Shahid x Mastercard — Gone**: Collaboration campaign between Shahid and Mastercard.
- **AXE — Evolution of Hooking Up**: Brand campaign for AXE.
- **AXE — Wingman**: Brand campaign for AXE.

## Clients & Partners

Shahid, AXE, KFC, Rexona, DU Telecom, Al Diriyah FC, Abtal x La Liga, CST. Agency partners include Ogilvy, BBDO, VML, Team Lewis, Goodpeople, Studio One, Vice, Copa90.

## About

We started in branding, got in early on social and digital, spent most of our careers at the biggest networks, then crossed to the client side. That's where it clicked — pretty is easy, moving the needle isn't.

So we built Reference. To take back control. Like a band.

No layers. No dilution. No endless rounds of feedback. We stay close to the work, make the calls, and keep the bar high. From strategy to concept to execution, production and delivery.
